items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Marvin Peterson is your trumpet player? ... I think I'll have a lot of the same players. Marvin can't make it ... I remember once when Marvin first played with us

ctx.x: Well (we had a misunderstanding (I got things wrong?) about that too. I came with two three thousand dollars They were going to pay transportation less than I had planned. It was (a misinterpretation?) I thought, but they didn't think so. ( ... Marvin Peterson ?).
Marvin Peterson is your trumpet player?
